subject: Pricing and SKU mapping for visibility add-ons (retention/tracing/dashboards)
messages:
From: Lisa Park <lisa.park@brightai.com>
To: Markus Klein <markus_klein@redwood.com>, Lauren Bishop <lauren_bishop@redwood.com>
Cc: Jonah Rivera <jonah@brightai.com>
Date: Wed, 7 Jul 2026 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Clarify visibility add-on pricing — retention / tracing / dashboards

Hi Markus / Lauren,

Thanks for the demo yesterday — the tracing capture and the dashboard drilldowns look promising. Before we move to procurement I need a clearer mapping of how you price the visibility pieces so I can present to our finance and infra teams. A few specific asks: 

- How do you structure retention pricing? Is it per-GB/month, per-token retained, or a flat slab (30/90/365)?
- For tracing: do we pay per host, per trace-ingest, or is it included as a module with a CVR for long-term retention?
- Dashboards: is that seat-based, query-based, or a bundled add-on? Can we buy dashboards for a single product team rather than company-wide?

Context: BrightAI will run ~6-10 production services, estimated 120M tokens/month across the few highest-throughput endpoints (burst to 400RPS). We care about a predictable bill and a path to keep cold archives for 12 months if needed.

Could you send a short SKU-level example (one-pager) with 1) base hosted inference price, 2) optional visibility add-ons with unit metrics, and 3) example total for our expected usage? If you can include a quick call slot tomorrow morning (PST) that would be great.

Thanks,
Lisa Park
CFO, BrightAI
ops@brightai.com

From: Markus Klein <markus_klein@redwood.com>
To: Lisa Park <lisa.park@brightai.com>, Jonah Rivera <jonah@brightai.com>
Cc: Lauren Bishop <lauren_bishop@redwood.com>, Priyom Das <priyom_das@redwood.com>
Date: Wed, 7 Jul 2026 11:03:00 -0700
Subject: RE: Clarify visibility add-on pricing — retention / tracing / dashboards

Hi Lisa — thanks for the clear context. Attaching a compact SKU one‑pager (pricing-sheet-v2.xlsx) and a short example table below so you can share with finance. We can also break any of these into custom slabs if you prefer.

High-level proposal (examples for BrightAI profile):

- Retention add-on (prefix/KV + logs storage)
  - 30-day: $0.03 per GB / month (suitable for tight SLAs)
  - 90-day: $0.02 per GB / month
  - 365-day: $0.012 per GB / month (cold tier, slower restore)

- Tracing capture
  - Basic: $250 / month per service (includes 7-day trace retention + sampling controls)
  - Advanced: $1,000 / month per service (full trace capture, searchable with 90-day retention)
  - Alternate model: $0.0005 per trace-ingest event if you prefer usage-aligned pricing

- Dashboards / Advanced analytics
  - Team dashboard (up to 10 editors): $500 / month
  - Org dashboard (unlimited viewers, up to 5 editor seats): $1,200 / month
  - Ad-hoc query credits: $0.10 per query after included monthly bucket

Example BrightAI monthly estimate (approx):
- Expected retained storage: 8 TB active (30d) with 0.5 TB cold -> Retention (30/90 mix): ~$250–$900/month depending on bucketing
- Tracing: 6 services on Advanced: 6 x $1,000 = $6,000/month (or ~ $2,400 if Basic + higher ingest pricing)
- Dashboards: 1 Team dashboard + 1 Org dashboard: $1,700/month

Net add-ons sample: $8k–$9k/month on top of hosted inference.

Concessions we can consider: 12-month commit on add-ons -> up to 20% discount; or a blended commit across inference + visibility for a better blended rate. I noted two paths in the attached sheet.

Proposed next steps:
- Quick call to align SKU mix (I have availability Thursday 08:30–11:00 PST)
- If agreed, we will send a formal quote + purchase order / DocuSign link for a 12-month pilot bundle

Attachments: pricing-sheet-v2.xlsx (compact SKU examples), link to short trace demo recording (trace-demo-recording.mp4)

Best,
Markus Klein
Director, Strategic Accounts — Redwood Inference
markus_klein@redwood.com

From: Lauren Bishop <lauren_bishop@redwood.com>

Subject: RE: Clarify visibility add-on pricing — retention / tracing / dashboards

On Wed, Jul 7, 2026 at 11:03 AM Markus Klein <markus_klein@redwood.com> wrote:
> High-level proposal (examples for BrightAI profile):

Quick note to call out a couple of practical options we often use for accounts your size:

- Hybrid retention: keep 30-day hot on the fast retention SKU and move everything older to the 365-day cold slab automatically; customers see ~40–55% lower retention cost with minimal restore impact.
- Tracing seat v. ingest: for teams that run 8–12 services we recommend Advanced per-service up to a 6-service cap, then convert to ingest-pricing above that cap — prevents surprises and keeps invoices predictable.
- Dashboards: we can sell a single-team dashboard as a scoped SOW if you want to pilot for one product org. That keeps enterprise-wide seats optional.

Concession language we can offer in the formal quote: 15% off visibility add-ons for a 12-month commit, or 20% off if you sign a combined inference+visibility annual commitment > $150k ARR. Priyom — please flag any legal/finance constraints before we send the doc.

— Lauren
Group Product Manager, Redwood Console
lauren_bishop@redwood.com
